claims: NASA successfully landed humans on the moon six times between 1969 and 1972.
NASA's moon landings started with Apollo 11.
382kg of moon rock was brought back.
Laser-reflecting mirrors are still on the moon's surface.
Other nations provided third-party tracking of the Apollo missions.
Scientists globally verified that moon rocks collected cannot be faked due to their formation in a vacuum with extreme radiation.
The Soviet Union tracked the Apollo missions.
The Soviet Union acknowledged the Apollo achievement.
Missing stars in moon landing photos have been explained by photography techniques.
The "waving" flag in moon landing photos has been explained by lack of air resistance.
Hundreds of thousands of people worked on the Apollo program.
No credible whistleblower has emerged to confirm a hoax of the Apollo program.
The moon landing flag was held up by a horizontal rod.
The flag "waved" while astronauts handled it.
With no air resistance, the flag continued to move temporarily.
Moon landing hoax theories began in the 1970s.
Moon landing hoax theories were fueled by distrust in the government during the Vietnam War.
